name: @vismay/curious-pipeline
description: The Curious Desk's provenance-first claim pipeline: source policies, polite fetching, collectors (GDELT, Library of Congress, Europeana, Gallica), candidate detection, atomic-claim extraction, lineage-aware dedupe, explicit-feature grading and the Supabase store. Pure modules take an injected fetch so they test on fixtures; store.ts is server only. Its own package so pipeline changes only rebuild admin and the vizmaya-fyi scripts.
